stories.title: 'They clearly care about the story' | Author Colin Meloy talks 'Wildwood,' Laika's newest stop-motion animated adaptation
stories.summary: Colin Meloy, The Decemberists frontman, wrote the 2011 middle-grade fantasy novel with his wife, Carson Ellis. Now, it's on the big screen. Here's how it got there:

stories.title: Why Oregon ski resorts still have a TBD opening date
stories.summary: Warm, rainy weather is limiting snow conditions at many Oregon ski resorts, leaving all still unopened.

stories.title: 2 arrested after viral video attempt triggers active shooter panic at Clackamas Town Center
stories.summary: Deputies responded to reports of an active shooter but found there had been no shots fired — it was two men attempting to film a viral video. Both were arrested.

stories.title: Portland shoppers skip big box stores for Indigenous art, vintage finds on Black Friday
stories.summary: While many Black Friday shoppers hit major retailers, some Portlanders chose a different path, supporting local artisans, Indigenous makers and small businesses.

stories.title: City could pay $109K to settle lawsuit over Rene Gonzalez campaign finance penalties
stories.summary: The city fined Gonzalez for violations during his 2024 mayoral campaign. He later sued, alleging the enforcement process was unconstitutional, and a judge agreed.

stories.title: Port now says SEA Airport had 'limited' notice before ICE arrest
stories.summary: U.S. Rep. Pramila Jayapal said the Department of Homeland Security told her the airport in Seattle was notified one day before the arrest.

stories.title: Multnomah County Sheriff's Office urges shoppers to watch for holiday theft, scams ahead of Black Friday
stories.summary: From fraudulent delivery messages to stolen packages, the sheriff's office is urging shoppers to take precautions during the holiday season.

stories.title: Fred Meyer celebrates 40th annual Black Friday sock sale and community sock drive
stories.summary: Fred Meyer is again partnering with the Salvation Army for a sock drive. Donations made at Fred Meyer stores will stay local.

stories.title: Officials searching for 2 people reported missing near the Salmon River in Otis
stories.summary: Misty Aalto and Cyrus Buchholz went missing Wednesday, after doing landscaping work at a property along the Salmon River.

stories.title: Portland groups serve free Thanksgiving meals to those in need: 'Pulling out all the stops today'
stories.summary: Portland organizations serve free Thanksgiving feasts, bringing warm meals, community and connection to people in need.

stories.title: Firefighters contain rooftop fire at Jackie's bar in Southeast Portland
stories.summary: Firefighters extinguished a rooftop fire at Jackie's, a popular Southeast Portland bar, which said it will reopen Friday, Nov. 27.

stories.title: 'Wildwood' hitting Portland movie theaters for free this Thanksgiving weekend
stories.summary: A love letter to Portland and handmade art, 'Wildwood' will be playing at several theaters across the metro area for free on Sunday, Nov. 29.
